title: Generating Gastruloids from Mouse Embryonic Stem Cells
protocol: Maintain mESCs in ESLIF medium on 0.1% gelatin-precoated tissue culture-treated plastic in a humidified incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Passage the mESCs to new flasks every other day.
Exchange 50-66% of the culture medium for fresh, pre-warmed medium on alternating days.
Culture the mESCs for at least two passages post-thawing before experimental use.
Culture cells to 40-60% confluence at the point of passaging or experimental use.
Routinely test all cell lines for Mycoplasma contamination.
Pre-warm PBS, ESLIF, N2B27 and Trypsin-EDTA in a 37°C waterbath.
Aspirate the medium from the T25 tissue culture flask and rinse gently with 5 ml PBS twice.
Aspirate the PBS and add 1 ml of pre-warmed Trypsin-EDTA to the flask.
Rock the flask to detach the colonies of cells. If required, strike the wall of the flask gently a few times or incubate at 37°C for 30 seconds.
Dissociate the colonies into a single cell suspension with a P1000 micropipette tip by ejecting the suspension forcefully against a wall of the flask.
Neutralise the Trypsin-EDTA with 5 ml ESLIF and transfer to a centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge the suspension for 3 minutes at approximately 170 x g.
Aspirate the supernatant and add 5 mL warm PBS.
Centrifuge the suspension for 3 minutes at approximately 170 x g.
Aspirate the supernatant and add 5 mL warm PBS.
Centrifuge the suspension for 3 minutes at approximately 170 x g.
Aspirate the PBS, minimizing carry-over by tilting the tube to remove as much as possible while leaving the pellet intact.
Fully resuspend the pellet in 1 mL N2B27 using a P1000 micropipette.
Load the hemocytometer (or the counting slide of an automated cell counter) with 10 μL of cell suspension and determine the density of the suspension.
Determine the volume of suspension required to produce a cell concentration of 7.5 mESCs/μL or 20 miPSCs/μL in N2B27.
Add the calculated volume of suspension to the required amount of N2B27, mix well and transfer to a sterile reservoir.
Vortex the suspension prior to plating or pipette it up and down within the reservoir.
Pipette 40 μl of plating suspension into each well of a sterile, U-bottomed non-tissue culture-treated 96-well plate with a multichannel micropipette.
Position the droplets in the bottom of each well to ensure efficient aggregation.
Confirm that cells can be seen within each well using an inverted benchtop microscope.
Return the plate to the incubator for 48 hours.
Pre-warm N2B27 in the 37°C water bath.
Prepare secondary medium as a 3 μM Chiron solution in N2B27.
Transfer 150 μl of secondary medium to each well using the multichannel micropipette and a sterile plastic reservoir.
Return the plate to the incubator for a further 24 hours.
Pre-warm N2B27 in the 37°C waterbath.
Carefully remove 150 μl of the secondary medium from each well using the multichannel micropipette, holding it at an angle to aspirate slowly from the side of each well.
Add 150 μl of fresh, pre-warmed N2B27 to each well using the multichannel micropipette.
Return the plate to the incubator for a further 24 hours.
Repeat steps to exchange 150 μl culture medium for fresh, pre-warmed N2B27.
If maintaining the culture, repeat steps to exchange 150 μl culture medium for fresh, pre-warmed N2B27.
To prolong the culture, transfer the gastruloids individually into low-attachment 24-well plates in 700 μl volumes of fresh N2B27 at 120 hours.
Incubate on an incubator-compatible orbital shaker for 48 hours at 40 RPM.
Replenish the medium after 24 hours by exchanging 400 μL of medium for fresh N2B27.
